manifest.name: DOOM
manifest.author: nanoTracker / id Software (shareware) / Jacob Enget (doom.wasm, GPL-2.0)
manifest.description: DOOM as a nanoTracker instrument. Bundled doom.wasm (GPL-2.0, shareware WAD embedded). Notes drive the controller: C=forward D=back E=turn-L F=turn-R C#/D#=strafe F#=fire G=use A=run(shift) A#=enter B=escape. Top octave (C-7+) selects weapon 1-8.
